description: Semantic search across the collection, the same engine as the chat on nerdnoir.ai. Returns the closest notes with slug, title, a short excerpt, and the page URL, best first. Optional filters narrow by frontmatter. For a signed-in reader with workshop access, results can include slides from those workshop decks (kind "slide"). Read a note in full with get_note. For Nerd/Noir's judgment on the reader's own situation, use lil_nerdy_ask_question instead.

filters.description: Frontmatter filters. All of them must match.

key.description: Frontmatter field: type, framework, source, tags, authors, and so on.

op.description: eq/neq: scalar frontmatter equality. in: scalar is in a list. has: an array field (such as tags) contains the value. link_eq: a frontmatter wikilink resolves to the given slug.

value.description: A string, or a list of strings for `in`.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words.

name: search_collection
title: Search the collection
